hook: Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.
caption:
Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.

Here's what nobody talks about: ChatGPT doesn't know if you're a person who needs the big picture first before the details matter — or if you're someone who needs the details first before the big picture makes sense.

It doesn't know you think in systems.
It doesn't know you hate bullet points.
It doesn't know you need one clear recommendation, not five balanced options.

So it guesses. Every. Single. Time.

And the guess is always the same generic middle-ground answer designed to not be wrong for anyone — which means it's not exactly right for you either.

That low-level friction you feel when an AI response is *technically fine* but somehow still misses? That's not a you problem. That's a calibration problem.

BootFile fixes this by building a profile of how YOUR brain actually processes information — your thinking style, your communication preferences, your decision-making patterns.

Then every AI interaction starts from *you*, not from the average of everyone.

Link in bio to build yours.
